name: Cabinets
description: Cabinets and millwork: base, drawer, wall and tall cabinets placed along a wall in the plan and drawn in a front view, built from your construction rules (frameless 32 mm system by default), with a cut list by material, edge-banding totals, a nest of every sheet, a DXF of the sheets for your CAM program and a bar-coded label for every piece in cutting order.
author: CadCraft
